slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory reports that the Republic of Congo inaugurated the National Personal Data Protection Commission as its data protection authority, following appointment of its leadership under a decree issued on 31 December 2025.

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority; no document opened

facts.fact: The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records that Congo ratified or acceded to the Malabo Convention on 2020-09-24 and deposited its instrument on 2020-10-23.

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Congo-Brazzaville has established a National Personal Data Protection Commission, whose members were installed by ICT minister Leon Juste Ibombo, who described it as an independent body able to advise, warn and sanction.

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority; no document opened

facts.fact: TechAfrica News states that Decree No. 2025-538 completes the institutional framework established by Law No. 29-2019 of 10 October 2019, and the Commission under it was inaugurated; the article gives no commencement date, so the date is the article's publication date of 22 January 2026.

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports that the National Personal Data Protection Commission was inaugurated after its members were appointed under Decree No. 2025-538 of 31 December 2025, and that its President, Vice President and Rapporteur were elected at the inaugural meeting.
